payload.summary: v27 already built a 1449-row post-tool-call cognitive curriculum across goal formation/revision/abandonment, initiative, abstention, clarification and result formulation, with 4180 answer-side tool tags reduced to zero. Its 4261 rejected generations are a high-value negative corpus. Audit history also proves two reusable rules: training/runtime prompt semantics must share one versioned source, and internal intent/hypothesis markers must not share a generic tool namespace. Blind review caught its own moving-target bug and bound results to a corpus hash.
